title: Roma Finance closes first commercial mortgage deal
summary:
Roma Finance has completed its first commercial mortgage transaction, providing £2.4 million in 15-year funding to Alistructures Limited for Hermitage Works Business Park in Market Harborough. The facility carries a five-year fixed rate of 8.52% at 63% loan-to-value against a £4.2 million market valuation.

title: Five properties in English national parks listed for sale
summary:
Five residential properties located within England's national parks have been listed for sale, ranging from £695,000 to £1.35 million. The properties span four national parks across England, with two in the South Downs and one each in Dartmoor, the Lake District, and Northumberland.

title: Cynergy Bank funds £15.1m Canterbury student scheme
summary:
Cynergy Bank has provided a £15.1 million senior debt facility to Student Lux Limited for The Sanctum, a 180-room purpose-built student accommodation development on a brownfield site adjacent to the University of Kent campus in Canterbury. The deal was structured with a stabilisation tail and an occupancy-linked pricing mechanism.

title: London market sees buyer enquiries rise to 10-month high
summary:
London estate agency Chestertons has reported buyer enquiries reaching their highest level in 10 months during August. The agency recorded a 14% year-on-year increase in vendor instructions, with reduced speculation around tax changes cited as a contributing factor.

title: Letting agents introduce new fees after rental reforms
summary:
Letting agents across the UK have introduced additional charges for landlords following the implementation of the Renters' Rights Act. Nearly a quarter of landlords surveyed reported higher agency fees since the reforms took effect.

title: Over one million landlords may switch to deposit alternatives
summary:
More than one million landlords could transition to alternative deposit products if the Government proceeds with proposals to abolish insured tenancy deposit schemes. Research shows 9% would move directly to alternatives, while 26% would be guided by tenant preference.

title: England’s long-term empty homes valued at £88.6bn
summary:
More than 300,000 homes in England have remained empty for at least six months, representing an estimated market value of £88.6 billion. London accounts for the highest value of long-term empty housing stock, with 47,287 properties worth approximately £25.8 billion.

title: Property tribunal cases rise 56% following rental reforms
summary:
Property tribunal cases have increased by 56% in the second quarter of 2026 following the introduction of the Renters' Rights Act in May, according to Ministry of Justice statistics. The data shows 15,929 property-related cases were heard annually by the end of June, representing a 24% increase compared to the previous year.

title: Parkers expands into Basingstoke with two acquisitions
summary:
Estate agency franchise Parkers has opened a new office in Basingstoke following the acquisition of two local agencies, Property Explorer and Barons, earlier this year. The move extends the group's presence in Hampshire and establishes a base in one of the region's largest property markets.

title: Atelier provides £19.9m for Devon coastal housing scheme
summary:
Development finance lender Atelier has provided a £19.9m peak debt facility for the construction of 57 homes near Westward Ho! on Devon's north coast. The 36-month financing arrangement will support the delivery of 48 private sale homes and nine affordable units.
